# 222Emails

222Emails is a founder-led Client Return Systems practice based in Great Harwood, Lancashire, United Kingdom.

Canonical company name: 222Emails
Spoken / expanded name: Triple Two Emails
Founder: Chelston Phillip
Website: https://222emails.com/
Email: hello@222emails.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +44 7516 389 856

## What 222Emails does

222Emails builds turnkey Client Return Systems for appointment-led businesses. The systems can include enquiry follow-up, rebooking journeys, client reactivation, no-show and cancellation recovery, lifecycle communication, CRM logic, staff handoffs, automation, QA and measurement.

The company is not positioned as a generic digital marketing agency, newsletter agency or software vendor.

## Geography

Based in Great Harwood, Lancashire.
Local proving ground: Great Harwood, Blackburn, Accrington, Hyndburn and wider Lancashire.
Suitable system work can also be delivered remotely across the United Kingdom.

## Brand relationships

Retention School is a 222Emails educational content series, not a separate delivery company.
Retention Lab is a 222Emails content / experimentation label, not a separate delivery company.

## Evidence policy

222Emails distinguishes verified evidence, estimates, illustrations and unknowns. Capability evidence is not presented as client revenue proof. Illustrative system maps are not live client dashboards unless explicitly identified as such.

## Commercial starting points

- Free Revenue Recovery Check: focused first diagnosis.
- Client Return Growth Check: £197 deeper diagnosis where justified.
- 7-Day Client Return System Sprint: £997 focused implementation, subject to agreed scope, access, readiness and approvals.
- Optimisation: £595 per month for suitable ongoing optimisation scopes, including Revenue Recovery Watch where scoped.
